_comment: RECURRENT-TIME-AXIS ablation of the CURRENT DEPLOY MODEL (lisennet_conv_hardened_nc24_deep_relu6: FP32 3.084 / int8 3.014, RF 196, 4.83 ms/frame). Single-variable swap: the inter-time stack (3 blocks x dilations [1,2,4,8,16], RF 196 = 3.1 s) becomes a GRU over time (unbounded RF). Everything else identical: n_blocks 3, relu6, batchnorm, convtranspose, intra_kernel 11. hidden_dim 20 keeps params 1.4% BELOW the conv reference (45,600 vs 46,248) so the comparison is conservative — a win here is not a capacity win. This is the head-to-head the paper needs: the conv model buys its 3.1 s of context by recomputing a 196-frame FIFO every frame; the GRU gets unbounded context from a 20-wide state. Train into cp_lisennet_hybrid_deep_relu6.
